subject: Eval kickstart: proposed trial map & success metrics for Silvershore
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie O'Neill <jamie.oneill@silvershore.health>, Alex Costa <alex.costa@silvershore.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Oct 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Eval kickstart: proposed trial map & success metrics for Silvershore

Thanks again for a productive demo today — appreciate the candid overview of the ACU discharge workflow and the two pain points you highlighted (summarization drift in provider notes; slower retrieval for multi-source queries). Per our conversation, I put together a short trial map and a suggested set of success metrics so we can quickly align on scope and owners. Attached: Silvershore_TrialMap_v0.1.pdf (includes timeline, datasets, and acceptance gates).

Proposed 4-week trial at a high level:
- Week 0 (prep): access, sample export (PHI-scrubbed), authentication & network checks (VPC peering or dedicated connector) — owner: Silvershore infra (Alex) + Redwood onboarding (Ben)
- Week 1–2 (validation): run 2 evaluation tracks — (A) Summaries: 500 notes against ground-truth; metric: ROUGE-L / human score (target >= 0.78 human acceptability)
  (B) Retrieval: 10 canonical multi-source queries; metric: 95th-pctl latency < 600ms and relevance precision@3 >= 0.85
- Week 3 (stability & load): traffic profiling at 50 qps equivalent for query patterns; monitor latency, cost/unit, and KV-cache hit rate
- Week 4 (handoff): review, signoff, and recommended production configuration (batching, quantization profile, routing policy)

Immediate asks for you to confirm so we can lock timeline:
1) Are the two evaluation tracks above representative of the success criteria you care about?
2) Who will be the technical owner on your side for network & data extracts (we heard Alex, please confirm)
3) Any compliance constraints (retention window, on-prem requirements) we should bake into the prep phase?

Next steps I propose after you confirm: Ben will kick off the onboarding checklist (API keys, test data instructions) and Karthik will scope expected cost and target model variant suggestions. I can send a light SOW to formalize the dates if you'd like — I attached a redline-capable SOW template to expedite.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync early next week if that helps.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Silvershore_TrialMap_v0.1.pdf (7 pages; timeline & metrics), Redwood_SOW_template.docx
From: Jamie O'Neill <jamie.oneill@silvershore.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Costa <alex.costa@silvershore.health>
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval kickstart: proposed trial map & success metrics for Silvershore

Marissa — thanks for the write-up and the clear map. This looks very aligned with our goals. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Summaries: the 500 notes sample is great. We will provide a de-identified dump from the last quarter; the clinical team will do a small manual review set (20 notes) for human acceptability grading. The 0.78 ROUGE-L target sounds reasonable as a starting point.
- Retrieval: for latency, the 600ms 95th is what we'd like to aim for; note that some queries include attachments (pdfs from the chart) — we'll flag those in sample queries.
- Compliance: Silvershore requires that audit logs are retained for 3 years and all keys are customer-managed (we use Azure Key Vault). Is that supported in the Private deployment plan?

Owners: Alex will own the data extract and network. I'll be the business lead and handle stakeholder coordination (clinical ops + procurement).

Timeline: we are hoping to start the prep work the week of Nov 3 — is that feasible for Redwood? If so, please send the onboarding checklist and we can route the SOW through procurement.

Quick note: can you include a rough estimate of expected token costs for the trial (ballpark) so procurement has a headcount for budgeting?

Thanks,
Jamie
VP, Digital Transformation — Silvershore Health
jamie.oneill@silvershore.health | +1 (212) 555-0147

- I will spin up a Private evaluation lane (VPC peering + Azure KV integration) — estimated 3 business days once we have Alex's network contacts and an SSH bastion + CIDR range.
- Karthik: can you produce a ~2-slide cost estimate to include token burn assumptions for the 4-week trial (low/med/high usage)? Procurement will want that in the SOW.

Jamie — great, Nov 3 works on our side. Next steps so we can get procurement + infra moving: 
1) I'll send a short SOW today that includes: start/end dates (Nov 3 – Nov 28), acceptance gates (summaries + retrieval thresholds), audit log retention, and Azure KV integration language. The SOW will include the optional OCR add-on as a separate line item.
2) Ben will provision the Private evaluation lane; Alex, can you please share the network contact and CIDR range (or a time to troubleshoot)?
3) Karthik will send the cost estimate (three-tier) by EOD tomorrow so you can attach it to the procurement packet.
4) Jamie, we'll also include a one-page checklist for test data export (PHI-scrub instructions).

Attached again: Silvershore_TrialMap_v0.1.pdf. I have the SOW in draft and will post the DocuSign link when it's ready (expect within 24 hours).

If helpful, let's hold a 20-minute kickoff on Nov 4 to validate the data extract and runbook — propose 11am PT; let me know if that works.

Looking forward — we want to make this low-friction.
